# Mafia 54: USS Ziusudra
*Chronicle of the historical match hosted by Gwynedd*

### Chapter 1: The Briefing & Setting
--- Welcome to Mafia 54. The USS Zuisudra is about to understand the issues that come with being a generation ship. --- The storyThe USS Zuisudra was a generation ship launched 60 years ago, travelling to Occisor in the Trappist-1 system. Advances in technology meant that this 39 lightyear trip would take 400 years to complete. The original residents of the Zuisudra were long dead, but hopefully one of their descendants would be alive to see Occisor in person. But some on board the Zuisudra had formed the opinion that the mission was doomed, they needed to turn around now and return to Earth for their sake and the sake of their descendants. The only way to do that would be to conduct a mutiny and take control of the Zuisudra. Arthurius Sanza had been taught by his parents that it was the job of everyone on the ship to do their part to make sure the ship made it safely to Occisor. As he grew up he saw his parents work themselves to death. He remembered in history class reading about the Earth, it hadn't been so bad after all. So why then not turn back?
